# Vendored libraries

Unmodified copies of these open-source builds, bundled so the site has no CDN dependency.

| File | Package | Version | License |
|---|---|---|---|
| `supabase-2.117.3.js` | `@supabase/supabase-js` (`dist/umd/supabase.js`) | 2.117.3 | MIT |
| `marked-18.1.1.js` | `marked` (`lib/marked.umd.js`) | 18.1.1 | MIT |
| `purify-3.4.17.min.js` | `dompurify` (`dist/purify.min.js`) | 3.4.17 | MPL-2.0 OR Apache-2.0 |
| `highlight-11.11.1.min.js`, `hljs-github*.min.css` | `@highlightjs/cdn-assets` | 11.11.1 | BSD-3-Clause |

To update one, download the new version from npm and replace the file (and the `<script>`/`<link>` tag in `index.html`).
